description: This file contains SQL scripts for creating procedures and triggers related to HR schema, including access control during business hours, and maintaining job history on employee updates.

methods.name: secure_dml
methods.description: Procedure to restrict DML operations outside business hours.

methods.name: secure_employees
methods.description: Trigger to invoke secure_dml before modifications on employees table.

methods.name: add_job_history
methods.description: Procedure to insert a record into JOB_HISTORY table.

methods.name: update_job_history
methods.description: Trigger to call add_job_history after updates on job_id or department_id in employees table.
